dataset.name: House Sales in King County, USA
dataset.acquired_from: GitHub mirror of the Kaggle file provided by the acceptor on 2026-10-18; its sha256 equals the value pinned in the Brief (§4), so no re-pin

structural_checks: sqft_living = sqft_above + sqft_basement on every row

split.method: grouped random split by house id: sorted unique ids permuted with numpy default_rng([seed, 0]); the first round(test_fraction * houses) houses are the test set

cv.method: grouped folds on the training set: sorted unique training ids permuted with numpy default_rng([seed, 1]) and dealt to the folds in turn; made once and shared by every method, k and comparison model

excluded_source_features.name: sqft_basement
excluded_source_features.reason: sqft_living = sqft_above + sqft_basement on every row, so the three columns are perfectly collinear; sqft_basement is dropped and the other two stay

date.definition: sale_days = (sale date - base_date) in whole days

yr_renovated.definition: is_renovated = 1 if yr_renovated > 0 else 0; yr_renovated_effective = yr_renovated if yr_renovated > 0 else yr_built

zipcode.encoding: one-hot over the categories of the training rows of each fit; the first sorted category is the baseline and has no column; a category not among the fitted ones is encoded as the baseline (all zipcode columns 0)

preprocess.encoded_column_order: feature groups in canonical order (CSV column order); within a group: date -> sale_days; yr_renovated -> is_renovated, yr_renovated_effective; zipcode -> zipcode_<category> in sorted category order without the baseline
preprocess.standardization: only for Ridge/Lasso: every encoded column except the zipcode one-hot columns is centered and scaled with the training mean and population standard deviation of that fit; OLS subset models use raw scale

target.point_prediction: exp(f(x)), no bias correction (a conditional-median estimate, not the conditional mean)

test_inputs.note: Rows are written only by the one-time test-evaluation export behind the test gate, in the same run as the test results (DA TR-01).

winners.selection_metric: CV RMSE (USD), grouped 5-fold on the training set

tie_break.overall: fixed method order allin > forward_sfs > backward_sfs > rfe > lasso_path

winners.note: Test evaluation is authorized only for these OLS subset models (each scored once) plus the metric-only Ridge and Lasso (CC-1); no other model is scored on the test set, and test results never change these winners.
